question: The normal temperature of a human body is _____________
solution:
The correct answer is __**98.6º F**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The normal temperature of a human body is **98.6º F**.
 
• This temperature is considered the average body temperature for a healthy individual.
 
• Body temperature can vary slightly depending on the time of day and the method used for measure
